about: UNVERIFIED geometry (the original report named no dungeon): advanced-pull camps picked across a vertical breadcrumb seam. The trail's 12yd discontinuity guards measured in 2D, so a drop-down seam that is short in plan view but a long vertical jump stayed contiguous. A camp picked across it landed on the wrong floor, and stock MoveTo fell back to a straight spline, which is the 'tank/party runs under the map' symptom. Fixed in 0ee8deb5: 3D trail measures, and every committed camp is PathGenerator-probed for PATHFIND_NORMAL. Staged on LBRS's Bloodaxe platform (z57, at a Bloodaxe Worg spawn) over the spider ledge (z30) toward Vosh'gajin. That is the 2D-short, 27yd drop that DcNavPenaltyRegistry boxes off as navmesh shortcut #1, so the route and trail can cross a vertical seam right before a forced advanced pull on the Spire Spider pair.
